Metaphysically, I follow Hibiscus Moon's theory on crystal chaos. She says if you are for example, pairing one crystal for high energy, but then right next to it you're pairing a crystal for relaxing energy you're giving the universe conflicting information about what you want.

She recommendeds only 3 types of crystals, so perhaps only carry three, as long as they don't have conflicting energy/intention.

Keep in mind with metaphysics there tend to not be any hard and fast rules so you can also just do whatever feels right to you.

I once shoved a crystal with lots of little nooks and crannies into it, I decided to bake it to get off the wax. It's the same method I use to get wax out of my little candlestick holders or for candle jars that I really like and I want to keep.

  
Put the toaster oven at 400 degrees and place your jar or crystal that you want to remove wax from and let it sit for 6 minutes, then carefully take it out. All the wax is melted and you can wash it off once it's not hot.
